mounts.skycraft.none: You don't own a mount. Stablemasters sell them, and a wild one can be broken in with a saddle.
mounts.skycraft.died: Your %s has fallen. Give it time to recover before you call it again.
mounts.skycraft.needs_saddle: It needs a saddle before it can be ridden.
mounts.skycraft.legend_bound: A legendary steed answers to you now. Call it with your mount key.
mounts.skycraft.bags.title: Saddlebags: %s
mounts.skycraft.bags.not_active: Only the mount you ride out on carries your saddlebags.
item.skycraft.shadowmere_bridle.tooltip: The black horse of the Dark Brotherhood answers whoever holds this.
item.skycraft.arvaks_skull.tooltip: Bound to the skeletal steed of the Soul Cairn. Use it to summon Arvak.
dialogue.skycraft.stables.buy_mount: I'd like to buy a %s (%s gold) - speed %s, stamina %s, saddlebags %s
dialogue.skycraft.stables.buy_marsh_shoe: No beast crosses the marsh? Then sell me marsh-shoes. (%s gold)
mounts.skycraft.bags.spilled: What no longer fits in the saddlebags goes into your pack.
mounts.skycraft.saddle.use_menu: It is already saddled. Sneak-use it to change its tack.
mounts.skycraft.gear.wrong_breed: That breed will not take that saddle.
mounts.skycraft.gear.fixed: Its tack is its own and does not come off.
mounts.skycraft.gear.not_gear: That does not fit this mount.
fauna.skycraft.tame.spooked: It was not calm: it bolts. Let it settle, then creep up.
item.skycraft.pack_saddle.tooltip: Broad panniers for the road: carries the most, tires the mount sooner.
item.skycraft.war_saddle.tooltip: High cantle and stirrups: a longer gallop and a harder charge. Not for ponies.
item.skycraft.noble_saddle.tooltip: Court tack, light and fast. Only the finer breeds take it.
mounts.skycraft.downed: Your %s is down. It will get up when the fight is over.
mounts.skycraft.rose: Your %s gets back on its feet.
mounts.skycraft.downed.call: Your %s is down and cannot come until the fight is over.
mounts.skycraft.downed.cannot_ride: Your %s is down and cannot be ridden.
mounts.skycraft.stance.follow: Your %s will fight at your side.
mounts.skycraft.nature.rider: A riding horse of the holds: quick and sure.
mounts.skycraft.nature.court: A court horse: graceful, fast, fine-boned.
mounts.skycraft.nature.hardy: A hill pony: small, tough and tireless.
mounts.skycraft.nature.legend: A legend: its own stock, its own nature.
mounts.skycraft.nature.draught: Colovian draught stock: strong in the back.
mounts.skycraft.nature.swift: A light, fast breed bred for show and post.
mounts.skycraft.nature.war: A warhorse: heavy, hardy and slow to tire.
mounts.skycraft.nature.desert: A desert steed: the best wind of any horse.
mounts.skycraft.nature.camel: A caravan beast: endurance and the biggest loads.
mounts.skycraft.nature.guar: A pack guar: steady, tough and strong.
mounts.skycraft.nature.cat: A great cat: fast and strong, carries little.
mounts.skycraft.nature.wolf: A giant wolf: quick, tireless on the hunt.
mounts.skycraft.nature.indrik: An indrik: graceful, swift, a light jumper.
mounts.skycraft.nature.mammoth: A mammoth: slow, immense, carries a house.
mounts.skycraft.nature.grazer: A tamed grazer: patient and sure-footed.
mounts.skycraft.sheet.none: Nothing is known of this animal.
mounts.skycraft.sheet.need_sense: The Riding perk Horse Sense lets you read grades and numbers.
mounts.skycraft.sheet.hint: Growth: each pip is a point it has gained, up to what its grade and kind allow.
mounts.skycraft.flinch: Your %s flinches from you. It trusts you less.
mounts.skycraft.rested: Your %s is rested from its time in the stable, and trusts you more.
mounts.skycraft.fed_wild: The %s takes it warily, and watches you.
mounts.skycraft.fed_enough: The %s has had enough for now.
mounts.skycraft.tame.hint: A / D: steer against the bucking - keep the marker in the green
dialogue.skycraft.stables.browse: Show me your horses, and what mine would fetch.
mounts.skycraft.stable.saddle_no: Your %s will not fit it: it goes to your bags.
mounts.skycraft.stable.barding_no: Your barding will not fit it: it goes to your bags.
mounts.skycraft.stable.gone: Someone else was quicker: that animal is gone.
mounts.skycraft.stable.nospace: There is no room to bring it out here.
mounts.skycraft.stable.bought: The %s is yours. The stable hands see to your old tack and your bags.
mounts.skycraft.stable.nothing_to_sell: You have no mount to sell.
mounts.skycraft.stable.sold: Your %s goes back to the stable for %s gold. Your tack and bags are returned.
mounts.skycraft.stable.trained: The stable hand puts your %s through its paces: %s improved.
mounts.skycraft.stable.train.none: You have no mount a stable hand can train.
mounts.skycraft.stable.train.note: Training adds one growth point, never past what its grade and kind allow.
perk.skycraft.riding.horse_sense.desc: Read a mount's grades and numbers: on target cards, its sheet and at the stable. Without it you only see words like swift and sturdy.
perk.skycraft.riding.wild_eye.desc: Tell what a wild mount is, and size it up from sixteen blocks. Without it a wild animal is only an animal.
perk.skycraft.riding.steady_seat.desc: Breaking a mount in: the bucking builds more slowly, the safe zone is wider and you may brush the edge longer.
perk.skycraft.riding.pack_master.desc: Your mount carries 10% more weight and saddlebag capacity per rank.
perk.skycraft.riding.endurance.desc: Your mount's gallop burns 12% less stamina per rank.
perk.skycraft.riding.trick_rider.desc: Blows from the saddle do 6% more damage and jumps cost your mount 15% less stamina, per rank.
